title: Activity Log
subtitle: Every create, update, delete and sign-in across the system.

deleteRange.title: Delete by Date Range
deleteRange.warning: This permanently deletes every activity log entry created in this range. There is no soft-delete/undo for log entries.
deleteRange.confirm: Delete every activity log entry between {start} and {end}? This is a permanent hard delete and cannot be undone.
deleteRange.deleted: {n} activity log entry deleted. | {n} activity log entries deleted.
deleteRange.failed: Failed to delete entries in this range.
